_comment: This document describes products and their properties.

products.name: Medium Roast Ground Coffee
products.description:
Crafted in the AllDay tradition, House Blend Medium Roast Coffee is rich and never-bitter
Complex, medium-bodied ground coffee with caramel undertones and bright aromatic flavor
Made with 100% Arabica coffee beans

products.name: Espresso Italiano
products.description:
Our Italian Roast Espresso Coffee is a Delicious Dark Roast with Tangy Red Fruit Undertones. Made from 100% Arabica Coffee Beans.
Available in Whole Bean or Pre-Ground as 16 oz, 2 lb and 5 lb bags. 
An Exclusive Artisanal Blend of Our Single-Origin Coffees.
In Order to Reduce Our Carbon Footprint, All Our Coffees are roasted in our Environmentally Friendly Roaster.
Proudly Roasted, Blended, and Packaged in the USA.

products.name: Colombian Fresh Roasted
products.description:
Balanced, full-bodied medium roast with a smooth finish
100% Arabica coffee grown in Colombia
Roasted and packed in the U.S.A.

products.name: Light Roast Ground Coffee
products.description:
Bright and smooth morning blend with citrus notes
100% Arabica coffee beans
Roasted and packed in the U.S.A.

products.name: Swiss Water Decaf Espresso
products.description:
All the flavor, none of the caffeine
Swiss Water Process decaffeinated espresso roast
100% Arabica coffee beans

products.name: Dark Roast Whole Bean Coffee
